login.demoUser: You will enter as {{name}} ({{role}}) in the sample projects.

login.noAccount: Accounts are created by a Super Admin. Contact an admin if you do not have one.
login.remember: Keep me signed in on this device

login.rememberHint_other: Stay signed in for {{count}} days, even after closing the browser. Do not tick this on a shared or borrowed computer.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Pick a project to start working. You only see projects you are a member of.
projects.empty: You are not a member of any project yet.
projects.emptyAdmin: Create the first project, then add team members through Team & Settings inside the project.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.statusNote: Counted from the latest attempt of each test case in a run. Retests are not double-counted; Blocked, Skipped and Not Tested never count as passed.
dashboard.noRuns: No runs in this project yet.
dashboard.noBugs: No bugs in this project yet.
dashboard.noRunCases: No test cases have been scheduled in a run yet.

cases.title: Test Cases
cases.subtitle: Library of test case definitions. Test results are recorded separately in each run.
cases.empty: No test cases in this project yet.
cases.emptyFiltered: No test cases match the filters.

caseDetail.notUsed: This test case has not been used in any run yet.
caseDetail.stepsPreserved: Step text is shown exactly as in the source.
caseDetail.archiveBody: The case is hidden from the active list. Its run history and revisions are kept, and it can be restored.
caseDetail.archivedNotice: This test case is archived. Restore it before editing.

runs.title: Test Runs
runs.subtitle: A run is a set of test cases executed on a given environment and build.
runs.empty: No runs in this project yet.

runDetail.snapshotNote: Title and version come from the snapshot taken when the case joined the run, so later edits never change past results.
runDetail.emptyFiltered: No test cases with this status.
runDetail.empty: This run has no test cases yet.

confirmBody.ACTIVE: Once started, testers can record results. Test cases can still be added.
confirmBody.COMPLETED: Results can no longer be recorded until the run is reopened.
confirmBody.REOPEN: The run becomes active again so testers can retest.
confirmBody.LOCKED: A locked run is final: results, test cases and assignments can no longer change. This cannot be undone.

notice.PLANNED: The run has not started. Add test cases and assign testers, then start the run.
notice.COMPLETED: The run is complete. Reopen it for retests, or lock it once the results are approved.
notice.LOCKED: The run is locked and final.

runDetail.addHeading: Add test cases to the run
runDetail.addHint: Only Ready test cases can be added. Their definition is frozen as a snapshot.
runDetail.addedSkipped: {{added}} added, {{skipped}} skipped (already in the run or not Ready).
runDetail.removeTitle: Remove {{count}} test cases from the run?
runDetail.removeBody: They can be added again later. The test case history is kept.
runDetail.removeBlocked: Test cases that already have results cannot be removed.
runDetail.removed: {{count}} test cases removed from the run.

bugs.title: Bug Tracker
bugs.subtitle: Defects from UAT runs and from user reports.
bugs.empty: No bugs in this project yet.

bugDetail.noLinked: Standalone bug - not linked to a test execution.
bugDetail.statusNote: The change is recorded in the status history with your name.

statusHint.VERIFIED: Make sure the retest passed. Earlier test results do not change.
statusHint.REOPENED: Explain why the bug is reopened, e.g. the retest still fails.
statusHint.WONT_FIX: Explain why the bug will not be fixed.
statusHint.CLOSED: A closed bug can still be reopened if it happens again.

bugDetail.workflowHint: Flow: Open → In progress → Fixed → Ready for retest → Verified → Closed.
bugDetail.unlinkBody: The test result is not deleted; only its link to this bug is removed.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.body: {{feature}} is built in Milestone {{milestone}}. See the roadmap in the README.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address you opened does not exist or has moved.
notFound.project: Project not found, or you are not a member of it.
notFound.item: This item was not found in the project.

caseForm.codeHint: Leave empty to generate one, e.g. UAT-AUTH-001.
caseForm.statusHint: Draft cases are not used in runs yet; Ready cases can be added to a run.
caseForm.stepsHint: One step per line, starting with a number (1., 2., ...). Text is stored as written.
caseForm.versionNote: Saving creates version {{next}}. Runs already in progress keep their own version.

members.title: Team & Settings
members.subtitle: Who can access this project and with which role.
members.emailHint: The account must already exist (created by a Super Admin).
members.removeBody: Access to this project is revoked immediately. Their work history is kept.
members.readOnly: Only project ADMINs can change members.

projectSettings.moduleCodeHint: Upper case, no spaces, e.g. AUTH.
projectSettings.readOnly: Only ADMINs and QA Leads can add modules and suites.
projectSettings.moduleCodeEditHint: Existing test cases keep their current code (e.g. UAT-LPL-001); new test cases use the new module code. Use the new module code when importing.

profile.title: My profile
profile.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. A long sentence is safer than a short complex word.
profile.mismatch: The confirmation does not match the new password.
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
profile.demoNote: DEMO mode: password changes are not really stored.

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.subtitle: Devices that can still open your account without signing in again. If you do not recognise one, sign out all other devices and change your password.
devices.notRemembered: Signs out when the browser closes or after inactivity
devices.revokeBody_one: {{count}} other device will be signed out and must sign in again. This device stays signed in.
devices.revokeBody_other: {{count}} other devices will be signed out and must sign in again. This device stays signed in.
devices.revoked: All other devices have been signed out.

adminUsers.title: Manage users
adminUsers.subtitle: Super Admin only. New accounts get a temporary password shown once.
adminUsers.superAdminLabel: Make Super Admin (full access and settings)
adminUsers.tempPasswordBody: Shown only this once. Hand it over securely and ask the owner to change it in Profile right away.
adminUsers.deactivateBody: They are signed out of every device immediately and cannot sign in until reactivated.
adminUsers.forbidden: This page is for Super Admins only.
adminUsers.permanentHint: Owner account: nobody can revoke or deactivate it from the website.

cycles.title: Test cycles
cycles.subtitle: A cycle groups several runs within one UAT period.
cycles.empty: No test cycles in this project yet.
cycles.codeHint: Upper-case letters, digits and hyphens. Example: CYCLE-2-2026
cycles.dateOrder: The end date must not be before the start date.
cycles.editCodeHint: Letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore (e.g. PHASE-1). Existing runs and bugs stay linked to this cycle.

runForm.urlHint: Address of the site under test, starting with https://
runForm.invalidUrl: The URL must start with http:// or https://
runForm.created: Run {{code}} created. Add test cases, then start the run.

execution.newerVersion: The test case was updated to version {{current}} after it joined the run. This page keeps using snapshot version {{version}} so results stay consistent.
execution.noSteps: Steps are not numbered. Follow the step text above.
execution.actualHint: Required when failed. Describe what happened, not what was expected.

locked.PLANNED: The run has not started. Results can be recorded once a QA lead starts the run.
locked.COMPLETED: The run is complete. Ask a QA lead to reopen it for retests.
locked.LOCKED: The run is locked. Results cannot change.

execution.notAssigned: This test case is assigned to {{name}}. You can only record results for test cases assigned to you.
execution.notAssignedNobody: This test case is not assigned yet. Ask a QA lead to assign it to you.
execution.readOnly: Your role can only view test results.
execution.bugsHint: A failed result never creates a bug by itself. Report a new bug or link an existing one.
execution.bugsNeedAttempt: Record a test result first to report or link a bug.

bugForm.fromExecution: This bug will be linked to {{run}} · {{case}} · attempt #{{n}}. The fields below come from that test result; review and complete them.
bugForm.titleHint: Short and specific, e.g. "Save button does nothing on the job form".
bugForm.assigneeHint: Only a QA lead or admin can assign a bug.
bugForm.lockedField: Some fields are locked because your role cannot change them.
bugForm.cycleFromRun: Leave empty to use the cycle of the run where this bug was found.

evidence.title: Evidence Center
evidence.subtitle: All evidence files of the project: screenshots, documents and logs. Only project members can open them.
evidence.empty: No evidence files in this project yet.
evidence.deleteBody: An unused file is hidden and can no longer be opened.
evidence.uploadHint: Files uploaded here can be attached later to test results, bugs or test cases.

imports.title: Import data
imports.subtitle: Test cases or bugs from UAT/tracker Excel files, the CSV template or AI JSON. Every row is checked before it is applied.
imports.leadsOnly: Only a QA lead or project admin can import.
imports.drop: Drag an XLSX, CSV or JSON file here
imports.rules: Up to 40 MB · Excel (many sheets, embedded screenshots) · CSV template · AI JSON v1.0
imports.empty: No imports in this project yet.

fileError.TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: The file must be XLSX, CSV or JSON.
fileError.SIGNATURE_MISMATCH: The content does not match the file type.
fileError.CORRUPT: The file is damaged or unreadable.
fileError.ACTIVE_CONTENT: The workbook contains macros and was refused.
fileError.DTD_NOT_ALLOWED: XML structure in the file is not allowed.
fileError.SCHEMA_MISMATCH: The JSON does not match the AI schema v1.0.
fileError.DEMO_XLSX: Excel import needs the server; in demo mode use CSV or JSON.

imports.targetQuestion: What do you want to import?

targetHint.TEST_CASES: A test case library, optionally with old UAT results (and screenshots).
targetHint.DEFECTS: Bugs from a tracker: failed rows and user complaints, with severity and screenshots.

importJob.sheetsHint: Select the sheets with the official test cases. Old versions or copies are better left out.
importJob.moduleHint: Used when a row has no module column.
importJob.mappingHint: Unused columns are still kept as source data.
importJob.noHeader: No header found automatically; enter the header row number.
importJob.mode: When a test case code already exists

modeHint.CREATE_ONLY: Skip existing ones. Safe for importing the same file again.
modeHint.UPDATE: Filled columns overwrite the old content; a new version is created.
modeHint.NEW_REVISION: The definition is fully replaced from the file; a new version is created.

importJob.resultsHint: Status, date, tester name (as text, no accounts are created) and embedded screenshots go into a new run. Test cases become Ready.
importJob.statusMapHint: Labels such as Closed/Open from Retest Status are never translated automatically; choose yourself or leave them without a result.
importJob.imagesAuto: {{count}} embedded images are linked to their rows automatically.
importJob.imagesReviewHint: These images are not on a test case row (e.g. a logo in the title area). Assign a row number or leave them out.
importJob.applyChanges: Apply the mapping changes and check again.
importJob.applyBody: {{create}} test cases are created and {{update}} updated. Invalid and duplicate rows are left out. Everything is applied at once.
importJob.applying: Applying the import… screenshots are being checked and compressed.
importJob.cancelBody: The uploaded file is deleted. No data changes.

done.PARTIAL: Import partly completed: rows with problems were left out.
done.FAILED: Import failed; no data was changed.

failure.COMMIT_FAILED: Something went wrong while applying; all changes were rolled back.
failure.INTERRUPTED: The server stopped while applying; all changes were rolled back.

importJob.noDataRows: No data rows below the header. Check the header row number and the selected sheets.
importJob.applyRun: Old results go into a new completed run "{{name}}".
importJob.codeConflict: When a code is already used by another test case
importJob.codeConflictHint: E.g. the hidden "... 3" sheet uses UAT-LPL-001 for different content. New code = the next number in that module; the original code is kept in the history.
importJob.conflictsHint: These codes are already used by test cases with different content. Decide per row, then press "Check" again.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: UAT results and bugs at a glance, data exports and the project activity log.

filters.rangeInvalid: The end date is before the start date; the end date is ignored.

reports.how1: Each test case in a run counts once, by its latest attempt. Retests are not counted twice.
reports.how2: Pass rate = Passed divided by all test cases in the runs. Not Tested, Blocked and Skipped never count as passed.
reports.how3: Periods are calendar days in WIB (UTC+7): runs whose period overlaps, attempts tested and bugs reported within the range.
reports.byTesterNote: Every attempt a tester recorded, retests included.
reports.defectsSummary: {{open}} open of {{total}} bugs for these filters.
reports.empty: No data for these filters yet.

export.heading: Export data
export.description: The filters above apply. Times are in WIB.

results.title: Latest result per test case
results.hint: One row per test case in a run: latest status, tester and linked bugs.

attempts.title: All attempts
attempts.hint: Every attempt including retests, with result, tester and test time.

defects.title: Bug list
defects.hint: Bugs reported for these filters, with linked test cases and runs.

cases.title: Test case library
cases.hint: Same format as the import template. Only the module filter applies.

export.tooLarge: Too much data (more than 50,000 rows). Narrow the filters.
export.leadsOnly: Only QA Leads or project Admins can export data.

activity.heading: Activity log
activity.description: Changes in this project are recorded automatically and cannot be edited. Visible to QA Leads and Admins only.
activity.empty: No activity for these filters yet.

adminProjects.title: Projects
adminProjects.subtitle: Every project on the website, archived ones included. The creator automatically becomes the project Admin.
adminProjects.createHint: You become the Admin of this project and can add team members afterwards.
adminProjects.codeHint: Capital letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 2-40 characters, e.g. KARIRHUB. Used in the project links; changing it later makes old links stop working.
adminProjects.name: Project name
adminProjects.archiveBody: The project can still be opened, reported and exported, but not changed until it is reactivated. Nothing is deleted.
adminProjects.empty: No projects yet. Create the first one to get started.
adminProjects.codeEditHint: Changing the code also changes the project's links; old links stop working. Existing bug codes stay as they are.

adminSettings.title: Site settings
adminSettings.subtitle: Apply to the whole website and every project. Changes take effect within seconds, no restart needed.
adminSettings.siteNameHint: Shown on the sign-in page and in the browser tab.
adminSettings.announcementHint: Shown as a strip above every page for all signed-in users. Leave empty to hide it.
adminSettings.defaultLocaleHint: For visitors who have not chosen a language yet.
adminSettings.supportContactHint: How to reach the administrators, shown on the sign-in page (e.g. team name and office WhatsApp).
adminSettings.sessionHoursHint: 1-72 hours. Applies to the next sign-in.
adminSettings.unusedFileDays: Delete uploads that were never used after (days)
adminSettings.unusedFileDaysHint: Evidence used in a result, bug or test case is never deleted automatically.
adminSettings.importDaysHint: Import history and per-row results are kept.
adminSettings.linkHoursHint: 1-168 hours. Applies to links created from now on.
adminSettings.rememberDaysHint: 0-90 days. Enter 0 to hide this option on the sign-in page. Remembered sessions do not time out after inactivity.

adminAudit.title: Site activity log
adminAudit.subtitle: Every change across the website: projects, user accounts and site settings. Cannot be edited.
adminAudit.empty: No activity for these filters yet.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.CONFLICT: The data conflicts with its latest state.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The data or file is too large.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: This file type is not supported.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please try again later.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.projectArchived: This project is archived and read-only.
errors.permanentSuperAdmin: The permanent Super Admin cannot be revoked or deactivated.

form.conflict: Someone else changed this item. Reload to see the latest version.

evidence.dropTitle: Drag files here or paste a screenshot (Ctrl+V)
evidence.rules: Screenshots PNG/JPG/WebP up to 15 MB · Documents PDF/DOCX/XLSX up to 25 MB · Logs TXT/CSV/JSON/HAR up to 20 MB

reason.SIGNATURE_MISMATCH: Content does not match the file type
reason.ACTIVE_CONTENT: Contains macros, scripts or embedded objects

note.NO_SIZE_GAIN: cannot get smaller without losing quality

evidence.caption: Caption for {{name}}
evidence.waitUploads: Wait until every file has been checked.
evidence.failedWarning: A failed result should come with a screenshot as evidence.

importIssue.UNKNOWN_STATUS: unknown status, not imported as a result
importIssue.NOT_RECORDABLE: "in progress" is not imported as a result
importIssue.EXISTING_CASE_KEPT: test case exists, its definition is kept

errors.RESET_LINK_ACTIVE: This account already has an active link. Revoke it first, or choose "Revoke & create new link".
errors.ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: The account is inactive. Activate it before creating a reset link.

request.title: Contact the administrators
request.subtitle: Only a Super Admin can help you recover an account. Your request goes straight to their list.
request.introPassword: Enter the e-mail of your account. After confirming who you are, an administrator sends you a link to set a new password.
request.introEmail: Enter your name and a way to reach you. An administrator will look up your account and tell you the registered e-mail.
request.contactHint: E.g. office WhatsApp number or another e-mail, so the administrator can confirm it is you.
request.messageHintEmail: E.g. your unit, your role in the project, or the e-mail you think you used.
request.tooMany: Too many requests from this network. Try again in 1 hour.
request.sentBody: If the details match an account, an administrator will contact you using the details you gave. Never share your password with anyone, administrators included.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.containsEmail: The password must not contain your e-mail name.
reset.doneBody: Every device that was still signed in has been signed out. Sign in with your new password.
reset.askAgain: Ask the administrators for a new link with the "Forgot password" form.

problem.INVALID: This link is unknown or incomplete.
problem.USED: This link has already been used.
problem.REVOKED: This link was revoked by an administrator.

dialog.title: Create a reset link for {{name}}
dialog.body_one: The link is valid for {{count}} hour and works only once.
dialog.body_other: The link is valid for {{count}} hours and works only once.
dialog.bodyNoHours: The link is valid for a limited time and works only once.
dialog.activeWarning: This account already has an active link. To never have two links for one account, the old link is revoked when the new one is created.
dialog.tipSend: Send it only to the account owner, through a contact you have verified.
dialog.tipOnce: The link is shown only this once. If it gets lost, create a new one (the old one is revoked).
dialog.tipWhat: When opened, the owner sees the account e-mail and sets a new password. All their sessions are signed out.

admin.title: Account recovery
admin.subtitle: Requests from the "Forgot password" and "Forgot e-mail" buttons on the sign-in page. Confirm who is asking through their contact, then create a time-limited reset link.
admin.howNotified: No e-mail is sent yet: the number of new requests appears as a red badge at Administration > Account recovery.
admin.activeLinksHint: An account can have only one active link. The bar shows the remaining validity.
admin.revokeBody: The link stops working immediately. You can create a new one at any time.
admin.ownerOnServer: The permanent Super Admin can only be recovered on the server: bash ops/testboard.sh create-admin --email <email> --reset-password
admin.noMatch: This e-mail matches no account. Link it to the right account if needed.
admin.findHint: Find the account that matches the name and contact above, then link it.
admin.handledAuto: Resolved automatically: the password was changed with the link
admin.noteHint: Optional, e.g. "E-mail told via WhatsApp". Only Super Admins see it.

reasons.INVALID_TRANSITION: its current status cannot move straight to that status

bulk.noOpenRun: No planned or active run yet
bulk.archiveBody: Archived test cases cannot be used in new runs. Old results stay, and a test case can be restored at any time.

merge.description: Choose the test case to keep. The others are archived and point to it. Old results do not change.
merge.archived: Archived and merged into the kept one
merge.mergedInto: This test case was merged into
merge.mergedIntoHint: Use that test case for new runs. If it was merged by mistake, restore this one.

similar.title: Similar test cases
similar.subtitle: Likely duplicates by similar title, expected result and bracket references (e.g. [FSD-LPL-001]). Codes are ignored, because different sheets can use the same code for different content.
similar.empty: No similar pairs. Try another module.

defectImport.sheetsHint: Tick the sheets that contain bugs. Hidden sheets are usually copies; leave them unticked if the content is the same.
defectImport.moduleHint: Module code for the bugs of this sheet. New modules are created automatically.
defectImport.cycleHint: Every imported bug goes into this cycle, e.g. UAT Phase 1.
defectImport.linkResultsHint: With an ID UAT column, each bug is linked to the latest result of that test case in the chosen cycle (failed ones first).
defectImport.stale: The settings changed. Press "Check again" before applying.
defectImport.counts: {{create}} bugs will be created · {{skipped}} rows skipped · {{duplicate}} already exist · {{invalid}} with problems
defectImport.imageCount: {{auto}} of {{total}} screenshots matched to their row
defectImport.statusMap: Status in the file → bug status
defectImport.applyBody_one: {{count}} bug will be created with its screenshots. Existing bugs are not created again.
defectImport.applyBody_other: {{count}} bugs will be created with their screenshots. Existing bugs are not created again.
defectImport.summary: {{created}} bugs created · {{skipped}} rows skipped · {{linked}} linked to results · {{images}} screenshots

public.tableSignIn: Sign in with a table card
public.footer: {{name}} · Testing the Labour Market services together
public.title: Together we make sure Labour Market services are ready for the public
public.subtitle: See the test phases in progress, the features being tried and the problems found. Workshop participants sign in with a table card, no e-mail or password.
public.cyclesSubtitle: Choose a phase to see the features to test and the problem list.
public.noCycles: No phase is open to the public yet. Please come back later.
public.stepsTitle: How to test at the workshop

gather.title: Sit at your group table
gather.body: Each table works together on the features chosen by the organisers.

scan.title: Scan the table card
scan.body: Point your phone camera at the QR code on the card, or type the 6 digits under it.

answer.title: Try it, then answer
answer.body: Follow the steps on screen, then press As expected, Not as expected, or Could not try.

photo.title: Tell us about problems
photo.body: Write what happened and take a photo. If another table already reported it, just press "Same".

public.notPublic: This phase is not open to the public, or it was closed.
public.noFeatures: No feature is open in this phase yet.
public.joinAsTable: I am a participant: sign in with a table card
public.nothingShared: The organisers have not shared details of this phase yet.

easy.leaveBody: Answers already sent stay saved. To come back, scan the table card or type its code.

NOT_YET.title: The table card is not valid yet
NOT_YET.body: This card works once the workshop starts. Please ask the organisers.

EXPIRED.title: The table card has expired
EXPIRED.body: This card is no longer valid. Thank you for testing with us.

REVOKED.title: The table card can no longer be used
REVOKED.body: The organisers blocked this card or made a new code. Ask them for the latest card.

closed.again: Sign in with a table card

join.title: Sign in with a table card
join.subtitle: Scan the QR code on the table card with your phone camera, or type the 6 digits printed on it.
join.staffWarning: You are signed in as {{name}}. If you continue, that account is signed out on this device.

error.WRONG_CODE: Unknown code. Check the 6 digits on the table card again.
error.NOT_YET: This card is not valid yet. Wait until the workshop starts.
error.REVOKED: This card was blocked. Ask the organisers for the latest card.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes or ask the organisers.
error.OTHER: Cannot sign in right now. Check the internet and try again.

join.noCard: No table card yet? The organisers hand one out at every workshop table.

members.title: Table members
members.hint: Names record who answered. Not accounts, a short name is enough.

tester.title: Who is answering?
tester.noMembers: No names yet. Press "Edit members" to add some (optional).

home.intro: You are testing {{cycle}} - {{project}}. Work through the features below one by one.
home.runClosed: The test sheet is not open yet or was closed. Wait for the organisers, then reload this page.
home.noRun: This table has no test sheet yet. Please contact the organisers.
home.featuresHint: Press the button on a feature to start. Progress is saved automatically.
home.noFeatures: The organisers have not chosen features for this table yet.
home.bugsHint: See problems from all tables, add "I saw this too", or report another problem.

photo.title: Photo of the screen (if any)
photo.hint: Take a photo of the computer or phone screen showing the problem. More than one is fine.
photo.waiting: Waiting for the photos to be checked...

case.whoHint: Tip: choose who is answering on the table page first, so the name is recorded.
case.question: After trying it, was the result as expected?

bugs.title: Problem list
bugs.subtitle: Problems found by all tables in this phase.

failed.title: Not as expected: tell us what happened
failed.whatHint: Use everyday words, e.g. "After pressing Save, an error appeared".
failed.maybeSameHint: If it is the same problem, press "Yes, the same as this" so it is not recorded twice.
failed.notSame: No, this is a different problem
failed.noteRequired: Please describe what happened, or choose the same problem.

blocked.title: Could not try
blocked.why: Why could it not be tried?

grid.title: All scenarios
grid.legend: Green = as expected, red = not as expected, yellow = could not try, white = not tried yet.

feature.notYours: This feature is not part of your table.
feature.empty: No scenarios for this feature yet.

workshop.noCycles: No phase yet. Create one under Test cycles first.

setup.cases: Test scenarios exist (Test cases or Data import)

setup.tables: Tables exist and each has features

board.inboxCta_one: {{count}} new problem from tables is waiting for review
board.inboxCta_other: {{count}} new problems from tables are waiting for review
board.noTables: No tables yet. Create them in the Tables tab.
board.noFeatures: No features yet. Add scenarios to a test run of this phase.

tables.created: {{name}} created. Print its card with Print card.
tables.createHint: The card code is generated. Member names may be filled in later by the table.
tables.name: Table name
tables.noRuns: This phase has no test run yet. Create one under Test runs first.
tables.runHint: The table's scenarios come from this run.
tables.featuresEmpty: Choose a test run first; features come from its scenarios.

print.step2: Or open {{address}} and type the 6-digit code.

print.qrLabel: QR code to sign in as {{name}}

guide.title: How to use TestBoard
guide.subtitle: A plain explanation of how TestBoard works and step-by-step use for workshop participants, facilitators and admins. No technical background needed.
guide.help: Still unsure? Ask the organisers or a facilitator in the room.

flow.intro: Think of TestBoard as a report card for a website being tested. From big to small:

project.title: Project
project.body: The website being tested, e.g. Karirhub.

cycle.title: Phase
cycle.body: One round of testing, e.g. Phase 1 (workshop on 30-31 July).

feature.title: Feature
feature.body: A part of the website, e.g. Job vacancy reports.

scenario.title: Test scenario
scenario.body: One thing to try: the steps and what should happen.

run.title: Test sheet
run.body: The scenarios worked on in one phase. It must be started before it can be filled in.

result.title: Result
result.body: As expected, Not as expected, or Could not try, per scenario.

bug.title: Problem (bug)
bug.body: Recorded when a result is not as expected, then fixed by developers and tested again.

flow.example: Example: project Karirhub > Phase 2 > feature Job vacancy reports > scenario "Save a vacancy report" in the Workshop Phase 2 run > result Not as expected > recorded as bug BUG-KAR-0012 > fixed by a developer > tested again.

participant.intro: Participants need no account. One table = one group working on the same features.

steps.title: Scan the table card
steps.body: Open the phone camera, point it at the QR code on the table card and tap the link that appears. Or open the address on the card and type the 6 digits.

steps.title: Choose who is answering
steps.body: On the table page, tap your name. It is recorded with every answer. If it is missing, press "Edit members".

steps.title: Choose a feature, then Start testing
steps.body: Each feature has a few scenarios. Progress is saved automatically.

steps.title: Read the scenario and try it on the website being tested
steps.body: Follow the steps one by one. The green box explains what should happen.

steps.title: Press one of the three big buttons
steps.body: See the buttons below. Once saved, press "Go to the next scenario".

steps.title: If not as expected: describe it and take a photo
steps.body: Write what happened in everyday words and photograph the screen. If another table already reported the same, press "Yes, the same as this".

participant.passed: As expected: the result matches the green "What should happen" box.
participant.failed: Not as expected: something is wrong, an error, or different. You will be asked to describe it.
participant.blocked: Could not try: the page would not open, there is no data, or the steps are unclear.

faq.a: Open the scenario again and press "Change the answer". The newest answer counts; the old one stays in the history.
Press A+ at the top of the screen. The size is remembered on that device.
Wait a moment and send again; the answer is never recorded twice. If it takes long, use the paper test sheet from the organisers.

faq.q: How do I take a screen photo?
faq.a: Easiest: press "Take a photo" and photograph the computer screen with the phone camera. Or use "Choose a picture" for an existing screenshot.

faq.q: Do I choose how severe it is?
faq.a: No. Facilitators decide that. Participants just describe what happened.

faq.q: The table card does not work.
faq.a: Cards only work on the workshop dates and may be replaced by the organisers. Ask them for the latest card.

facilitator.intro: Facilitators prepare the tables, follow progress and tidy the incoming problems. Everything is in the Workshop mode menu inside the project.

beforeSteps.title: Create a phase
beforeSteps.body: Test cycles > New cycle. Enter a code (e.g. PHASE-2), a title and the workshop dates.

beforeSteps.title: Prepare the scenarios
beforeSteps.body: Use Data import to bring scenarios from Excel, or add them under Test cases. Group them per feature (module).

beforeSteps.title: Create a test run and start it
beforeSteps.body: Test runs > New run, choose the phase, add scenarios, then set the status to Active when the workshop starts.

beforeSteps.title: Create tables
beforeSteps.body: Workshop mode > Tables > Create several tables. Then edit each table: choose features and (optionally) member names. Card validity follows the phase dates.

beforeSteps.title: Print cards and paper backups
beforeSteps.body: Print all cards (2 per A4). Also print a Paper backup per table in case the internet fails.

beforeSteps.title: Set the public view
beforeSteps.body: Public view tab. All data is hidden by default; switch the phase on and tick only what the public may see.

beforeSteps.title: Short rehearsal
beforeSteps.body: Ask 3-5 future participants to try one scenario with a sample card. Fix scenarios that confuse them.

duringSteps.title: Hand a card to each table
duringSteps.body: One card per table. Participants scan the QR or type the 6 digits.

duringSteps.title: Show the Big screen on the projector
duringSteps.body: The Big screen button opens a page with every table's progress, refreshed automatically.

duringSteps.title: Watch the Board
duringSteps.body: Spot tables that fall behind or have not started, and go and help.

duringSteps.title: Tidy Incoming problems
duringSteps.body: Set the impact, press "Same as" when it duplicates another, then Reviewed.

duringSteps.title: If a card leaks or is lost
duringSteps.body: Tables tab > New code (the old card stops working) or Block.

afterSteps.title: Set the test run to Completed
afterSteps.body: No more answers can be added once it is closed.

afterSteps.title: Enter results from paper sheets (if any)
afterSteps.body: Open the run under Test runs and fill in the results.

afterSteps.title: Read the reports and pass bugs on
afterSteps.body: Reports for the summary; Bugs to assign fixes to developers.

afterSteps.title: Close the public view if needed
afterSteps.body: Switch off Show publicly, or keep it on for transparency.

faq.q: Participants see "The test sheet is not open".
faq.a: Set the test run status to Active under Test runs.

faq.q: Two tables work on the same feature.
faq.a: That is fine. Both see the latest answer; every answer stays in the history.

faq.q: Many tables report the same problem.
faq.a: Participants are prompted to press "Same". Tidy the rest in Incoming problems with "Same as"; they count as "also seen".

admin.intro: Site admins (Super Admin) manage projects, accounts and settings. Everything is under Administration.

steps.title: Projects
steps.body: Administration > Projects: create projects, change their name or code, archive them.

steps.title: Users
steps.body: Administration > Users: create staff accounts (not table participants), deactivate them, make Super Admins.

steps.title: Project members
steps.body: Inside a project, Team & settings: add accounts to the project and choose their role.

steps.title: Forgotten e-mail / password
steps.body: Administration > Account recovery: create a time-limited password reset link.

steps.title: Site settings
steps.body: Site name, announcement, session length and the "Keep me signed in" duration.

steps.title: Activity log
steps.body: Who changed what and when, including public view and table card changes.

roleRows.can: Everything in that project, including members.
Prepares scenarios, test runs, Workshop mode, tables, public view, and reviews problems.
Records results and reports problems with their own account.
Sees and updates the status of bugs assigned to them.
No account; signs in with a table card and can only use the easy mode.

glossary.intro: Words in the menus and what they mean in everyday language.

items.plain: Testing by future users to make sure the website works for what they need.
One round of testing over certain dates.
A part of the website being tested.
One thing to try, with what should happen.
The scenarios worked on in one phase, with their results.
Something not as expected that needs fixing.
How serious a problem is, from Critical to Info. Set by facilitators.
Trying again after a problem was fixed.
A group of workshop participants working on the same features.
A printed card with a QR code and 6 digits to sign in without an account.
A sign that another table found the same problem, so it is not recorded twice.
Pages anyone can see without signing in; organisers choose what is shown, field by field.

points: All phase data is hidden from the public until organisers switch it on, and only ticked data is shown.
Karirhub screen photos can contain job seekers' personal data (ID number, name, phone). Avoid photographing real data, and never publish photos without checking them.
Table cards only work on the workshop dates, can be replaced or blocked any time, and cannot open staff pages.
Table member names are stored as text; no accounts are created. Every staff change is recorded in the activity log.
Do not tick "Keep me signed in" on a shared computer. Sign out other devices from the Profile page when needed.
